messages:
Priya (Billing): Heads-up — NeuroLattice (NL-904) INV-2026-0201 sitting at 28 days overdue. Total $31,200. AP emailed claiming an anomalous spike in embedding calls on 2026-03-28 and is disputing the overage lines. They want a credit or detailed usage export before paying.

Hector (AM): I spoke with their finance lead, Carla. She says a tagging bug routed test traffic to production model and generated ~2.3M extra embedding tokens. They're willing to pay base subscription but requesting we hold on the overage until we finish a reconciliation.

Priya (Billing): Collections policy note: standard disputes must be raised within 15 days of invoice; past that we still review but expect at least partial payment. CollectionsBot: sent dunning #2 this morning.

CollectionsBot: [auto] Dunning #2 sent to ap@neurolattice.ai (2026-04-20T09:05:00Z). Delivered.

Maya G.: We can be flexible if they cooperate. Proposal: require 50% of outstanding ($15,600) to be wired within 5 business days, and we will mark remainder as "under review" pending a technical reconciliation. They must provide usage logs and a post-mortem within 7 days. If reconciliation shows their claim valid, we'll credit the overage; if not, balance due in 14 days.

Hector (AM): Carla just asked if we can accept a 30% upfront instead of 50% — treasury is tight. She insists on not losing service.

Maya G.: 30% feels risky. Approve 50% firm. If they truly can't, offer 40% + company guarantee signed by a director. No fee waivers.

NeuroLattice AP: We can do 40% today and provide the usage export + PM within 6 days. Can you accept 40% + director guarantee?

Maya G.: Conditional approval: accept 40% ($12,480) if director guarantee signed and we receive usage export within 6 days. Otherwise 50% required. Jin (Billing) — please update invoice status to "under-review-temp-hold" and disable auto-suspend until first payment clears.

Priya (Billing): Will update ledger: note "temp-hold pending 40% + director guarantee + usage export by 2026-04-26". CollectionsBot: scheduling check-in.

LegalBot: [auto] Template director guarantee provided. Include clause: "guarantee secures unpaid balance pending dispute resolution; funds collectible on failure to reconcile."

CollectionsBot: [auto] Reminder scheduled for 2026-04-26T09:00:00Z.

Hector (AM): I'm sending the guarantee template to Carla now and CC'ing legal@redwood. Will confirm when payment lands.

NeuroLattice AP: Payment initiation confirmed (screenshot) and director guarantee signed & returned. Sending usage export now.

Priya (Billing): Uploading proof of payment and attaching files to invoice. Marking invoice flag: "payment-partial-received". We'll run reconciliation once billing team ingests logs.

Maya G.: Thanks team. If reconciliation clears in NeuroLattice's favor, we'll issue a credit and close thread. If not, notify Collections to bill remaining balance with standard late fees and escalate if unpaid in 14 days.
